derivation.source: canonical supplied SWAP 4.3.1 nested Fortran archive, independently re-read for F-VQ20

TCS7.DVS_knots: dvs_tc7 read with allowed range 0..2 and maximum 7 values

sensor.mapping: legacy dcrit is translated once to nodsen; F-VQ20 tests the already-pretranslated node-index contract

DCS2.DVS_knots: dvs_dc2 read with allowed range 0..2 and maximum 7 values

AFGEN.between_knots: linear interpolation between surrounding alternating x,y pairs
AFGEN.legacy_partial_table_sentinel: a decreasing next x terminates a partially filled legacy table and returns the preceding y
AFGEN.qualification_restriction: because legacy TCS7/DCS2 SAVE-array unused tails are not explicitly cleared after partial reads, F-VQ20 does not claim equivalence above the last explicitly supplied knot for partial tables; target fail-closed behavior is qualified as a restriction

outer_selection_gate.legacy_expression: sw_irrig==1 AND schedule==1 AND irrigevent==0 AND fl_cropemergence AND flIrriTime

DCS2_equation.target_translation: DCS2 table values are stored in the process parameter object as depth_cm after the 0.1 conversion

regular_positive_rate_single_node_SSDI.single_node_consequence: for nod_ssdi(1)==nod_ssdi(2), full-event external input equals irr_rate*duration = irr_depth
regular_positive_rate_single_node_SSDI.multi_node_hold: for more than one selected node, legacy scheduled total input scales with node count; F-VQ20 excludes this case

selection_cadence.standalone: Irrigation(3) scheduled selection is called under flDayStart when sw_multi_swap==0
selection_cadence.multiswap: Irrigation(3) scheduled selection is called under flDayEnd when sw_multi_swap==1, while Irrigation(4) availability application occurs under flDayStart
selection_cadence.target_abstraction: selection_opportunity is an explicit management/runtime event; the process kernel must not infer midnight, day number or one-day interval duration

equivalent_when: selection_opportunity corresponds to a legacy scheduled-selection call
all admitted outer management gates map true
TCS7 and DCS2 parameters are within canonical parser domains
partial-table runtime DVS does not exceed the last explicitly supplied knot, unless all seven knots are supplied
SSDI node range contains exactly one node
regular positive-rate path applies and duration <= 1 day
not_claimed: legacy stale SAVE-tail behavior for partial tables above their explicit last knot
